topic: Effect of propeller rotation on aircraft and methods used to counteract it
syllabus_extract: Effect of propeller rotation on aircraft and methods used to counteract it
specific_objectives: 7.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the various types of propellers, principles of operation and pitch change mechanisms.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of PPT diagrams; Instructor supervision required for safety during discussion of aircraft movement.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a propeller?
How does a propeller generate thrust?
Why is propeller rotation direction important?

development.content:
Definition of P-factor
Description of Gyroscopic Precession
Explanation of Torque Reaction
Identification of Spiral Slipstream
Overview of Propeller Efficiency

Principle of Torque Counteraction
Function of Tail Rudder
Role of Engine Mounting
Effect of Propeller Rotation Direction
Impact on Aircraft Handling

Methods to Counteract P-factor
Techniques for Gyroscopic Precession
Strategies for Spiral Slipstream
Importance of Pilot Input
Summary of Countermeasures

summary_questions: Explain how torque reaction affects aircraft yaw.
Describe the relationship between propeller rotation and P-factor.
List three methods used to counteract gyroscopic precession.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles discussed in this lesson apply to the constructional details of the Dornier A/C propeller covered in LP 02.

pft_rows.syllabus: Constructional details about Dornier A/C propeller, construction of blades and pitch change mechanism and spinner
